## Multiplex analysis  [methods]
[S164] Plasma samples from CPTs were stored at −80 °C before cytokine analysis. [S165] Assays were performed with the Beadlyte Human 22-Plex Multi-Cytokine Detection System with the addition of interferon-α2 and IL-1 receptor-α Beadmates to make a 24-plex assay (Upstate).
